verify.app.name: ITRMS document check
verify.check.forged: This code has been altered or forged. Treat the document as not genuine.
verify.check.notOurs: This code is not from a document of this system.
verify.check.offlineExpired: The signature is genuine, but by this phone’s date the document has expired.
verify.check.offlineGood: The signature is genuine and the document has not been altered. The office could not be reached, so this cannot show whether it was cancelled since. For anything serious, check again with a connection.
verify.check.unknownKey: This phone does not know the key that signed this code. Connect to the internet and scan again. If you still see this, treat the document as not genuine.
verify.page.compare: Compare these with the document in front of you. The name is partly hidden on purpose.
verify.page.state.busy: Too many checks from this address just now. Try again in a minute.
verify.page.state.noCode: Scan the code on a document to check it.
verify.page.state.offline: The check could not reach the office. Try again when you have a connection.
verify.page.state.unknown: This code does not belong to any document. Treat the document as not genuine.
verify.page.status.expired: This document was genuine, but it has expired.
verify.page.status.revoked: This document has been cancelled. It is not valid.
verify.page.status.superseded: This document has been replaced by a corrected one. It is not valid.
verify.page.status.valid: This document is genuine and valid.
verify.page.title: Document check
verify.scan.noCamera: The camera could not be opened. Take a photo of the code instead.
verify.scan.noCode: No code could be read from this picture. Try a closer, sharper photo.
verify.scan.notReady: Connect to the internet once to make this phone ready for checks without a connection.
verify.scan.photo: Take a photo of the code
verify.scan.ready: Works on this phone without a connection. Keys last updated on {day}.
verify.scan.title: Scan a document
